## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:Setup → 应用管理页里,当前默认应用那一行的「设为默认」星标按钮仍是禁用的,但现在会说明原因「Already the default app」(十一种语言):鼠标悬停和键盘聚焦都会弹出提示,读屏器也会把它读作按钮的描述。
- 为什么改:QA 发现这个星标禁用了却没有任何原因(悬停、聚焦、无障碍描述都没有),违反 ux-conventions.disabled-control-reason。
- 风险与回滚:只动 Console 一个页面和 i18n 包里新增的一个键;复用控制台已有的禁用原因组件(`useDisabledReason` + `DisabledReasonTrigger`),不新造模式,不碰服务端。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/apps/console/src/pages/system/AppManagementPage.tsx` 的新组件 `SetDefaultStar`;新测试 `AppManagementPage.defaultStarReason-33103.test.tsx`;`ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts` 里的 `appManagement.alreadyDefault`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/pages/system/__tests__/AppManagementPage.defaultStarReason-33103.test.tsx`,预期 6 条全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`ui/apps/console/src/pages/system/AppManagementPage.tsx`:

- The row's Set-default star moves into a small `SetDefaultStar` component (the reason is a hook and the rows are drawn in a loop). It reuses the console's existing disabled-reason pattern from `@object-ui/components`, the same one plugin-grid's inline row-action button uses: `useDisabledReason(isDefault, t('appManagement.alreadyDefault'))` gives the reason, the button points `aria-describedby` at it, and `DisabledReasonTrigger` wraps the button in the focusable span that opens the reason as a tooltip on hover and on focus and carries the same description. No second pattern was introduced.
- The reason is given only for the default app. `processing` (a write in flight) still disables every star, and gives no reason: it is the page's own transient state, not a fact about the app, which is how `disabled-reason.tsx` itself treats an execution in flight.
- The star's name, title, click handler and disabled condition (`processing || isDefault`) are unchanged.
- The file header gains a short section saying the above.

`ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts`: one new key, `appManagement.alreadyDefault`, in all eleven shipped locales (en "Already the default app"), next to `setDefaultNamed` and using each pack's existing word for "app" and "default".

`.changeset/33103-default-app-star-reason.md`: `patch` for `@object-ui/console` and `@object-ui/i18n`, both published (`files[]` ships `dist`), with the two declaration lines.

## Tests

New `ui/apps/console/src/pages/system/__tests__/AppManagementPage.defaultStarReason-33103.test.tsx`, through the rendered page, the real Radix tooltip and a real `I18nProvider` (the expected sentence is read from the shipped pack, not from the call site's `defaultValue`):

- the default app's star is disabled, and the star and its wrapper are both described by the reason;
- hovering the wrapper opens a tooltip with the reason;
- Tab reaches the wrapper, which takes focus and opens the tooltip;
- under `zh`, the description is the zh-Hans pack's sentence;
- CONTROL: a non-default app's star is enabled, has no `aria-describedby` and no reason wrapper;
- CONTROL: while a set-default write is in flight, another app's star is disabled with no reason, and comes back enabled when the write settles.

Ablation through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: the hook's argument `isDefault,` replaced by `isDefault && false,` (mutation landed, blob `1d889086` to `467c2a73`; restored, blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty). The four reason pins went red and both controls stayed green: 4 failed, 2 passed.

## Acceptance notes

- Measured first on `origin/main` `9499dcc5`: the star still read `disabled={processing || isDefault}` with no reason wrapper, so the card reproduced and this is a change, not a pin.
- `Clause-②: yes (widening)` measured on the diff: the only published-surface change is the added i18n key; no export, prop or key is removed or narrowed.
